import pathlib, textwrap, importlib.util
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace')
progdir=base/'programs'; progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a uniform, nonzero separator with equal-sized panels on each side.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0 and r == h - r - 1:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if len(set(vals)) == 1 and vals[0] != 0 and c == w - c - 1:
            return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][c + 1 + j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No centered uniform separator found")
'''
path=progdir/'task-321ece15.py'; path.write_text(code)
print(path)
